saadway-credentials.description: Dashboard credential management (constitution v1.1.0, Principle V — the single bounded exception to the strict dual-UI decoupling: the LuCI panel may manage the optional rpcd session credential of the 'saadway_login' mapping). Grants exactly one ubus method; the change is applied by the root-only provisioning helper (the secret is piped to the platform's passwd, never stored by the daemon). SCOPE (Phase 24 / T079, the auth bypass): the group is the narrowest grant for the method, but it is NO LONGER an exclusive boundary — the LAN-scoped 'unauthenticated' group in saadway/files/rpc-acl.json covers the whole saadway ubus object (the wildcard), so an unauthenticated LAN client can reach this method as well. The withdrawal and its residual risk are recorded in docs/verify-2512.md §7; keep this group as the narrow grant to use if the wildcard is ever tightened.
